title: Winnie the Pooh and the honey pot.
lines: Deep in the Hundred Acre Wood lives a little bear.
He is yellow and he wears a red top.
He isn't very clever, he says so himself, but he has a very big heart.
His name is Winnie the Pooh.
And there is one thing Pooh loves more than anything in the world.
Time for a little something, thinks Pooh.
That's where his honey pots are.
He looks in the first pot.
He looks in the second pot.
He looks in the third pot, and he puts his whole head in it.
What is a bear to do now?
The sun shines through the leaves.
High in a big oak tree hangs a beehive.
And where there are bees, there is honey!
Pooh tries to climb the tree.
He climbs up, branch after branch.
But he is a little too round.
And Pooh falls down, into a bush.
It's Piglet, a little pink piglet in a striped suit.
Pooh, what are you doing in that bush?
I'm looking for honey, says Pooh.
But the tree is too high.
They go to Christopher Robin's house.
Christopher Robin is a boy, and he is the best friend of all the animals in the wood.
I have an idea, says Christopher Robin.
Pooh holds on to the balloon.
And up he goes, floating into the air.
All the way up to the beehive.
I'm a little black rain cloud!
Then the bees will think I'm not a bear.
A bee lands on his nose.
I think the bees suspect something!
He sits down on a tree stump.
Tigger is a tiger with stripes and a tail like a spring.
Then Eeyore comes plodding along, the grey donkey.
And Rabbit, who has a vegetable garden.
And little Roo with his mummy Kanga.
You know, he says, I still have a pot of honey in my cupboard.
And I have some in my bag, says Kanga.
Everyone goes home and comes back.
Rabbit with a pot of honey.
Kanga with a pot of honey.
Tigger with a little pot, but he has secretly eaten a bit of it already.
Because that's what he likes to eat best.
But then he does something very kind.
He looks at all his friends.
They spread a blanket on the grass, under the big oak tree.
They eat honey on their bread.
Eeyore even smiles a tiny bit.
Pooh, he says, what's the very tastiest thing?
Pooh thinks for a very long time.
Then he says: Honey is very tasty.
But eating honey with friends, that's the tastiest of all.
